"Attack Reaction - {r}, destroy this: Create a Fang Strike in your hand." Battleworn is a printed keyword - it fires from the card DB keywords field and is deliberately NOT authored here.

The {r} is modeled as card-level activation_cost (DSL-authoritative), which play.py's shared cost gate charges on ACTIVATE_CARD actions; authoring it additionally as a PAY_RESOURCES cost would double-charge (IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE warning). The destroy-this half is the ability-level cost DESTROY_SELF, the exact pattern of Blacktek Whisperers' attack reaction (cost_types.py ~43, always payable, destroys via canonical destroy).

CREATE_TOKEN with destination "hand" resolves through getattr(controller, "hand") in effect_keywords.create_token (~372-376); same spelling as the adopted marlynn_treasure_hunter Goldfin-Harpoon-in-hand activation. The fang_strike token definition exists at json/fab/fang_strike.json.

Timing note, not a gap: play.py offers ATTACK_REACTION activations only to the ATTACKER during the combat reaction step (play.py ~286-289, citing CR 8.1.2a). That matches this card's use - Nuu destroys it during her own attack's reaction step - so no engine change is needed; flagged only so a reviewer knows defender-side use would not be offered.
